_comment: CDC scenario KEYS: Db2 CDC over the ASN SQL-Replication CD tables the db2cdc system registers for every model table, asncap copying each change a moment after it commits; column names arrive upper-cased and are matched without case. The CD tables carry the rows an ON DELETE CASCADE takes but not an UPDATE that changes nothing: --cascades logged --noops unlogged. Db2 has no snapshot isolation, so an initial load under changes may load a change and replay it too. Every way a row is identified, over four variants of the publisher (functions/caps_db2cdc.py), each in its own collection: db2cdc_in (start_from=tail, flattened rows), db2cdc_head (start_from=head), db2cdc_struct (columns_format=struct, flatten_columns=False), db2cdc_map (columns_format=map). STAGES: (1) domains -- create the db2cdc domain, install employeescdc, load the xs seed; (2) collections and (3) functions -- registering a stream publisher STARTS it; (4) actions, tagged live -- a 30s pause for the tail streams to attach (a change before that is not theirs to see), one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 30` pass (inserts, updates -- accounts' moving its key, ledger's by both columns of its key, devices' by its unique index, readings' by every column -- and deletes), then `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (5) sentinel -- hold until after-changes is in db2cdc_in and db2cdc_head; (6) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py checks db2cdc_in from the tail and db2cdc_head from the head: it replays each CD table from its origin, the create-data seed first (the tables are registered before it is loaded), one change at a time with its whole before-image and the row it leaves, nothing of audit (each its own lane: one failing does not hide the other); db2cdc_struct and db2cdc_map run over the same changes, unchecked: their rows nest the values the check reads flat; (7) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/db2cdc_keys --keep`.
